title: Information From Japanese Consulate Regarding Yang Chun, Chinese Student In Japan

page_data.en:
CONFIDENTIAL
DRAWER

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. B. REGISTER
File No.
Special Branch Station, 1—
REPORT
Date January 11, 1935.

Subject: Information from Japanese Consul regarding Yang Ch'un (楊濬), Chinese student in Japan.
Made by P. H. moto. Forwarded by.

The following information has been received by the local Japanese Consular Police from the Tokyo Metropolitan Police regarding a Chinese student named Yang Ch'un:-

Yang Ch'un was born in Singapore in 1911. In 1914, he was sent to his native place at Jung Tung Sien (瓊東縣), Kwangtung Province, where he received his preliminary education. In 1927, he came to Shanghai and entered the Higher Middle School Department of the Great China University. On graduating from this institution in 1930, he entered the Political Economy (特支) Department of the Shih Chi University, where he left in April, 1931 owing to his suffering from pleurisy. He, then, returned to his native place in Kwangtung Province where he remained until July, 1932 when he proceeded to Singapore to live with his father, Yang Doh Van (楊大蕃), a rubber merchant. In February, 1933 he again returned to his home in Kwangtung Province. On October 3, 1934 he arrived in Kobe and immediately proceeded to Tokyo where he entered the Toa (東亞) Higher Preparatory School for Chinese students. He is at present confined to his bed suffering from pleurisy. Nothing of an incriminatory nature was found in his property. However, as he lives with Yuen Pei Foo (雲盈波), a suspected Chinese Communist, at No. 6 Fumizono Cho, Nakano Ku, Tokyo, his movements will be carefully watched.

M. Thewlis.
D. S.

S2.
D. C., Special Branch. Please inform "A"
File JAG A 1935
SC. 811. "A" informed accordingly. JAG
SWR 14/1/35. JAN 11 1935

特务股登记簿
档案号
特务股分站，1—
报告
日期：1935年1月11日。

主题：日本领事馆提供的关于在日本的中国学生杨濬（Yang Ch'un）的情报。
由 P. H. moto 制作。转发者。

当地日本领事馆警察从东京警视厅收到有关一名叫杨濬的中国学生的如下情报：

杨濬于1911年出生于新加坡。1914年，他被送回广东省琼东县原籍，在那里接受初等教育。1927年，他来到上海，进入大夏大学高中部。1930年从该机构毕业后，他进入持志大学政治经济系（特支），后因患胸膜炎于1931年4月离校。随后，他返回广东省原籍，一直住到1932年7月，之后前往新加坡与其父、橡胶商人杨大蕃（Yang Doh Van）同住。1933年2月，他再次回到广东省家中。1934年10月3日，他抵达神户，并立即前往东京，进入东亚高等预备学校（Toa Higher Preparatory School）就读。目前他因患胸膜炎卧床不起。在其财物中未发现任何具有罪证性质的物品。然而，由于他与涉嫌为中国共产党的云盈波（Yuen Pei Foo）同住在东京中野区文园町6号，其行动将受到严密监视。

M. Thewlis.
副督察。

S2.
特务股副督察。请通知“A”组
档案 JAG A 1935
SC. 811. “A”组已获知悉。JAG
SWR 1935年1月14日。1935年1月11日

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O. BOX 259. SHANGHAI.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
11th December 1934 No. D
Date / /

VERY SECRET.

My dear Givens,

You may care to inform the Japanese Police
that there are good reasons for believing that one YANG
CH'UN (楊濬) residing at the following address in Tokyo
is actively engaged in Communist activities and in known
touch with Communists resident in Nan Yang (south seas).
日本東京中野区文園大番地
懸崖別墅楊.

Yours sincerely,
H. W. C. Pollock

File
JAS

T. Givens Esq.,
Special Branch,
S. M. P.

S.2, For attention please
Dec 8/3
Copy passed to Jap. authorities
with B.S. unmarked 20/12/34

英国驻上海总领事馆，
邮政信箱259号，上海。

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特务股登记室。
1934年12月11日 编号 D
日期 / /

绝密。

亲爱的吉文斯（Givens）：

你或许愿意告知日本警方，有充分理由相信，居住在东京以下地址的杨濬（YANG CH'UN，楊濬）正积极参与共产主义活动，并与居住在南洋（Nan Yang）的共产党人有已知联系。
日本东京中野区文园大番地
悬崖别墅杨。

此致，
H. W. C. Pollock

档案
JAS

T. Givens 先生，
特务股，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

S.2，请予关注
